SELECT 
  AVG(driver_totals.total_points) as avg_points_total,
  AVG(driver_totals.avg_laps) as avg_of_avg_laps
FROM (
  SELECT 
    driverId,
    SUM(points) as total_points,
    AVG(CAST(laps AS INTEGER)) as avg_laps
  FROM results
  WHERE grid >= 12 AND laps IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY driverId
) driver_totals
